project.name: QH :: Module :: Party :: 02 Core
project.description: PARTY (concrete identity root) with PERSON/ORGANIZATION detail tables, PARTY_MEMBERSHIP (the per-tenant boundary), PARTY_NAME/PARTY_IDENTIFIER, ADDRESS + PARTY_ADDRESS, CONTACT_POINT (+ CONTACT_POINT_ADDRESS), PARTY_ROLE, PARTY_GROUP (+ PARTY_GROUP_MEMBER for UBO tracking), CUSTOMER, ORGANIZATION_OFFICER, SIGNATURE_SPECIMEN and the central AUDIT_EVENT/AUDIT_FIELD_CHANGE trail. Every *_CODE classification column here is a real FK to a qh-module-party-reference catalog entity.
